race.title: Follow Us On Facebook At Limerick Races Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
race.verdict: SHOTGUN JACK had a tough race returning from 10 months off when second at Galway but it was a fine showing and he's well treated if building on that back at the scene of his last win. Chanceitlucky could be a big player from the front again, while the lightly-raced Jolly Potter is improving with each run in handicaps. SHOTGUN JACK (IRE) CHANCEITLUCKY (IRE) JOLLY POTTER (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Jolly Potter (4/1), Chanceitlucky (5/1), Political Stance (11/2), Spellacy's Cross (6/1), Vision De Maine (7/1), Shotgun Jack (8/1), Chasing Crowns (8/1), Cock And Bull (8/1), Creadan Grace (10/1), Mullanour (10/1), Kilkee Bay (12/1), Scathach (16/1), Inches Away (20/1), Prophetess Miriam (20/1), Rebel Queen (20/1), Fervida (25/1), Hakensack (33/1)
